name: Base64 URL-safe
summary: Encode and decode URL-safe Base64 (RFC 4648) — convert to and from standard Base64.
description: Encode UTF-8 text to URL-safe Base64 (-_ alphabet, no padding), decode it back, or convert between standard (+/) and URL-safe forms. Useful for JWTs, data URLs in paths, and tokens. Everything runs in your browser.

faqs.question: How is this different from standard Base64?
faqs.answer: URL-safe Base64 replaces + with - and / with _, and usually omits = padding so the string is safe in URLs and filenames.

faqs.question: Can I convert existing Base64?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Std → URL or URL → Std to swap alphabets and restore padding when needed.

faqs.question: Is my data uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Encoding runs entirely in your browser.
